Hon. Musa Yusuf Drogba

APCFika East Constituency

House of Assembly candidate

Public profile

Political party: All Progressives Congress (APC).
Constituency: Fika East.
Campaign line on poster: “Hope of the Peoples”.

Biography

Hon. Musa Yusuf Drogba was born in 1988 in Maluri, a community in Fika Local Government Area of Yobe State. He began his schooling at Maluri Primary School in 1996, went on to Government Secondary School, Damagum, and later studied at the College of Administration and Business Studies, Azare, the Federal College of Education (Technical), Potiskum, and the University of Maiduguri.

His listed qualifications include a BSc (Hons) in Political Science, a Diploma in Public Administration, a Certificate in Computer Operation and the NYSC certificate. An MSc in International Affairs and Development Study is noted as in view.

His public life began early. Between 2005 and 2007 he served as Youth Leader of the ANPP in Fika Local Government Area, and in 2007 he was Ward Returning Officer for Turmi/Maluri Ward. From 2011 to 2015 he worked as Special Assistant to H.E. Ibrahim Gaidam, then as Senior Special Assistant from 2016 to 2019.

He also took part in campaign organisation. In 2015 he was Zonal Youth Secretary of the Ibrahim Gaidam Campaign Organization and Director Youth of the Buhari Campaign Organization in Yobe State. In 2019 he served as Secretary of the Northeast Door-to-Door Campaign for Buhari and as a member of the Yobe State Campaign Organization, Zone B. In 2018 he was an aspirant for the House of Assembly seat representing Fika East. His stated interests are research, political analysis and business.

Compiled from the candidate’s CV. Confirm details with the campaign office before public release.
